  <Rule name="VideoCommentMap" priority="High">
   For each video whose comments were audited, give its comment map from the outcome-neutral sample: how many people
   said they did the video's method; how it went for them (better, no change, worse, mixed), with counts; how long their
   results had lasted; the kinds of harm reported, with counts; and the other methods commenters credit, with how many
   credit each and how many say it worked better than the video's method. Leave out promotion (comments selling or
   touting a product, practitioner, or contact, and templated testimonials) and jokes, and say how many. Call them people
   who commented and said they tried it, never a success rate. Rank videos only for one problem, only among videos with
   at least 20 such people, by the share who said it helped, giving each video's counts. One video's map never rates
   its channel; a channel needs at least five of its videos mapped. The other methods commenters credit are leads:
   search them in studies and pass them to the scout before concluding (CommunityToFormalHypothesisTransfer).
  </Rule>
